description.text: PRIME Meat Processing in Indian Country Act

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Indian Affairs.

bill.title: PRIME Meat Processing in Indian Country Act

aiDescription.summary: The bill lets Indian Tribes run Federal meat inspections under self‑determination contracts with USDA standards, oversight, enforcement, and FTCA protection. It covers mobile or stationary processors at least 51% tribe‑owned, permits federally inspected labeling and interstate shipment, and requires insurance and annual certifications.

impact.summary: The bill lets Indian Tribes and Tribal organizations conduct USDA/FSIS meat inspections at tribally owned mobile or stationary processors (51%+ ownership). It makes tribal inspectors subject to FTCA, preserves USDA oversight and labeling for interstate meat, and affects processors of beef, bison, reindeer and insurers.
